prompts.text: What kind of podcast do you enjoy when you want something easy to listen to?
Tell me about an episode that led you to learn more about an unexpected subject.
A relaxed interview with one guest or a lively discussion among familiar presenters?
You get to plan a short podcast about an ordinary interest. What would its first episode explore?
A good audio conversation can keep someone's attention without needing elaborate visuals.
An entertaining podcast doesn't have to be longer than the journey it's played during.
Which topic would you enjoy hearing two curious people discuss without trying to win an argument?
Recall discovering a podcast because somebody recommended one particularly good episode.
A friend wants an audio programme for a long journey. What would you ask about their taste?
A thoughtful interview about creative work or a light programme of surprising facts?
What kind of radio drama or audio story could keep you listening without pictures?
Describe hearing a storyteller create a vivid setting using only a voice and background sound.
An atmospheric mystery told through sound or a warm comedy with distinctive characters?
You have to make a five-minute audio scene set in a busy market. Which sounds would establish the place?
Listeners often imagine different faces and spaces when they hear the same audio story.
A simple sound effect can make an audio scene more convincing than a long explanation.
What everyday location would make a good setting for a short audio drama?
Recall a spoken story that made you feel as though you were present.
A local storytelling festival invites one original short audio piece. What kind of story would you submit?
Listen to a classic story read aloud or discover a contemporary audio-fiction series?
Which video game world would you explore even if you didn't have to complete any challenges?
Tell me about a game you enjoyed because of its characters rather than its difficulty.
A relaxed exploration game or a puzzle game that rewards patient observation?
Somebody has never played a video game and wants an easy introduction. What features would make a game welcoming?
Interactive stories can give people a sense of discovery that feels different from watching a film.
Games that allow people to move at their own pace deserve as much appreciation as competitive ones.
Which game soundtrack or visual style has stayed with you after you finished playing?
Recall playing a cooperative game with someone and discovering how differently you approached challenges.
You get to design a game about running a small neighbourhood shop. What would make its routine enjoyable?
Solve quiet mysteries through exploration or build and decorate a space creatively?
What quiz-show format would you enjoy joining with a few friends?
Describe knowing an unexpectedly obscure answer during a casual trivia game.
A general-knowledge quiz with varied subjects or a game focused on everyday observations?
You have to write five fun questions for a community quiz without making anybody feel excluded. What topics would you choose?
Quiz nights can be fun for people who don't win when the questions invite discussion.
A creative question can be more memorable than a difficult one.
Which subject would you volunteer to answer questions about on a team?
Recall watching a game show where the contestants' personalities made it entertaining.
A neighbourhood fundraiser includes a short quiz round. How would you keep the questions fair to different ages?
A fast round of humorous guesses or fewer questions with time to explain the answers?
Which museum exhibit feels like entertainment rather than a formal lesson?
Tell me about an exhibition you visited almost by accident and ended up enjoying.
Interact with hands-on displays or spend time looking closely at a small collection?
You can curate an exhibition about everyday entertainment from the past fifty years. What object would greet visitors?
An exhibit becomes engaging when visitors understand the stories behind ordinary objects.
A museum doesn't need expensive technology to encourage people to explore.
What object from recent popular culture deserves a place in a future museum?
Recall seeing a costume, prop or original artwork in person and noticing details photographs missed.
Your local museum wants to attract people who rarely visit. What kind of evening programme would you suggest?
A guided gallery tour with stories or independent browsing with a simple audio guide?
What kind of magic or illusion performance do you enjoy watching most?
Describe seeing a performer do something surprising and wondering how much was practice.
A close-up card trick or a large stage illusion with theatrical presentation?
You're organising a family-friendly evening with an illusionist. What would help both children and adults enjoy it?
Much of a magic performance's appeal comes from the storytelling surrounding the trick.
Knowing the secret of an illusion doesn't automatically make the performance less impressive.
Which harmless everyday skill could be presented as a convincing stage trick?
Recall watching somebody demonstrate an unusual dexterity skill during an event.
A performer offers to teach one safe beginner trick after a show. What would you choose to learn?
Watch a mind-bending puzzle performance or a humorous act built around misdirection?
What's something you enjoy about hearing people discuss a finished film or series?
Tell me about an interpretation of a story that you'd never considered until a friend mentioned it.
Hear a creator discuss why a scene was changed or listen to viewers compare their reactions?
You and a friend finish a series with opposite opinions about its ending. Which question should begin your conversation?
Stories can stay interesting after the credits because viewers notice different details.
Enjoying a story doesn't require agreeing with the choices every character makes.
Which fictional character would you like to hear interviewed as if they were a real person?
Recall learning a behind-the-scenes detail that changed how you appreciated a performance.
You host a friendly discussion after a screening with people who disagree. How would you keep it constructive?
Discuss how a story was made or debate which characters grew the most?
What's an entertaining event you've stumbled into without planning to attend?
Describe hearing music or laughter nearby and deciding to stay for a performance.
Spend an afternoon at a small creative market or attend a relaxed public demonstration?
Your town hosts a weekend event featuring many short performances. What would help visitors explore without rushing?
Surprising entertainment often comes from giving unfamiliar activities a little attention.
A smaller event can offer a better sense of community than an enormous festival.
Which kind of street performance would make you stop for a few minutes?
Recall somebody sharing a craft or talent in public that drew an appreciative crowd.
A group of local artists is planning its first open studio day. How could the day feel welcoming to newcomers?
Watch performers rehearsing in public or see the finished show with a lively audience?
What makes a creator's behind-the-scenes video worth watching?
Tell me about learning how a costume, set or visual effect was made and gaining new appreciation for it.
Watch a costume designer explain a look or a set builder demonstrate a practical effect?
You get to visit one department behind a theatre or film production. Where would you go?
Entertaining productions depend on skilled workers whose names most viewers never know.
Learning about production constraints can make a finished creative choice more impressive.
Which creative job behind a show would you enjoy trying for one afternoon?
Recall a rehearsal or making-of feature that helped you understand a difficult performance.
A school puts on a short play with minimal resources. Which backstage contribution deserves special attention?
Explore sound design and editing or discover how props and costumes are created?
What's a relaxed entertainment habit you've maintained through several stages of life?
Describe changing your tastes while keeping a fondness for one familiar kind of programme.
Save something new to watch each weekend or revisit favourites when you need an easy evening?
You have one entertainment-free day followed by a free evening. What would you most look forward to?
People's favourite forms of entertainment often change with their available time and energy.
Not keeping up with every popular release is a perfectly reasonable way to enjoy culture.
Which older entertainment format would you like to see gain popularity again?
Recall enjoying a shared activity with someone despite having very different tastes.
Your friends create an annual evening devoted to rediscovering forgotten favourites. How would you choose the programme?
Spend an evening discovering new talent or return to an experience that's made you happy before?
